inj.note: Officially placed on injured reserve Monday after suffering a quadriceps injury while filling in at center Sunday at Detroit; he will miss at least four games. With starting center Sean Rhyan (high-ankle sprain) also sidelined for Thursday night against Carolina, third-string option John Williams is in line at center, and Green Bay signed offensive lineman Mekhi Becton from the practice squad to the active 53-man roster.
